notes.subject: רפאים
notes.rationale: Refaim: kuw-mɔgɔw (shades, mɔgɔ-finw) walima sɔrɔdasi-hadenw jamana tɔgɔ (Genesis 14:5); 'sɔrɔdasi-mɔgɔw' daɲɛ b'a fɔ ko a ye dabali ye — YLT bɛ tɔgɔ yɛrɛ mara

notes.subject: השכל
notes.rationale: שכל ye hakili-senɛli, kun-habibɔ ye; 'hakili' bɛ kɔrɔ fitinin dɔ ta

notes.subject: דרך השכל
notes.ratiose: construct jɔcogo: 'sira min bɛ hakili bila' — Bamanankan bɛ u fila jɔ ka sira ye

translation: Hadamaden min bɛ yɛrɛ taa ka bɔ hakili sira la, o bɛ sigi Refaim (sɔrɔdasi-mɔgɔw) ka jama kɔnɔ.
